question: Should OpenClaw reintroduce `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated runtime compatibility contract, and is the inbound-shaped helper set sufficient?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but restoring a public plugin-runtime alias defines an upgrade and deprecation contract for third-party plugins that automation should not approve on its own.

options.title: Accept Object-Identical Alias
options.body: Refresh the branch and land `turn === inbound`, keeping `channel.inbound.*` canonical for new and migrated plugin code.

options.title: Broaden Legacy Helper Scope
options.body: Require compatibility for older helper names such as `runAssembled`, `runResolved`, `runPrepared`, and `dispatchAssembled` before merge if those names remain supported shipped API.

options.title: Reject Core Alias
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers decide old plugins must update or republish instead of restoring a core runtime alias.

recommendation.title: Accept Object-Identical Alias
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and land `turn === inbound`, keeping `channel.inbound.*` canonical for new and migrated plugin code.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the commit that removed the deprecated runtime alias, so the same owner is best positioned to decide the compatibility reversal.
